spec.description: Rectangular 70x40x20 plate with R5 corners, central O12 thru bore and two O6 thru holes, 1x45 deg on all top edges. Assumed: central bore is centred in X and Y; the two O6 holes are on the Y centreline and symmetric about the X centre with 46 pitch; 40 is depth along Y, 70 is length along X, 20 is thickness along Z.
spec.name: drilled_plate

chamfer_size.description: 45 deg chamfer size on all top edges

hole_pitch.description: distance between the two O6 hole centres along X
